subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: Should disabling the status card suppress only the chat presentation, return structured data from `session_status`, or provide a reduced textual status across both surfaces?
rationale: The request adds a new configuration and output-mode contract across a shared chat/tool renderer; source evidence does not establish which disabled response is intended or compatible.

options.title: One shared visibility setting
options.body: Keep the existing card as the default and define a single setting with explicit, tested reduced-output behavior for both chat and tool callers.

options.title: Chat-only presentation control
options.body: Hide the card only in chat while retaining the current detailed `session_status` tool response for agents.

options.title: Decline the configuration surface
options.body: Keep the current always-rendered diagnostic card and document that status output is intentionally available on both paths.

recommendation.title: One shared visibility setting
recommendation.body: Keep the existing card as the default and define a single setting with explicit, tested reduced-output behavior for both chat and tool callers.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review context and commit provenance connect steipete to the current shared status path and this issue’s prior routing decision.
